record.one_liner: Telegram messaging platform with an HTTP Bot API for building bots, plus MTProto user API and Telegram Login.
record.auth_notes: Bot API uses a bot token from @BotFather as part of the request URL. Telegram Login (bots/telegram-login) is an OIDC/OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow with PKCE, client credentials from BotFather. MTProto user logins use api_id/api_hash from my.telegram.org (not graded as a separate method here).
record.access_notes: A bot token is obtained by messaging @BotFather and issuing /newbot. No paid plan or approval step was seen in the fetched docs.
record.api_notes: Official HTTP Bot API with many methods (current version 10.5 on the docs page). Also an MTProto API for user and bot logins.
record.blocker_notes: Bot tokens are free and self-serve. Community MCP servers exist, but Telegram has no official one. Bot API use is the sanctioned route; MTProto userbot automation carries ban risk per a third-party article.
